scope: Four native Original-style captures; taken after final movement corner correction and visual treatment, before independent encounter support-budget fix. This is presentation evidence, not floor-composer validation.
observations: Closed and opened Frowning facial states are visible, but eye details are small at gameplay zoom. Closed capture partly overlaps a decorative post and needs a clearer later comparison.
Ordinary/Frowning share flesh material; Flaming uses a charred material and visible animated orange/yellow flame crown outside the head silhouette.
All use existing Original low-poly geometry and shadows. Source sprite shape/animation is adapted, not pixel-identical.
not_accepted: controlled performance; displayed short-capture FPS under concurrent compilation is not a benchmark
